verdict.rationale: Qdrant's source is public on GitHub (qdrant/qdrant), and its own llms.txt describes it as an Open-Source Vector Search Engine written in Rust. Independent community reports corroborate this: one names the Apache-2.0 license, another describes building it from source in Rust. Missing for 10: first-party documentation explicitly stating the license terms (the Apache-2.0 attribution comes only from a community comment).
